item.title: Model Request failed. Please try again later. (3003) with GLM 5.1 / GLM 5 Turbo (TRAE + TRAE SOLO)
item.body:
### Summary
“Model Request failed. Please try again later. (3003)” occurs when using GLM models in both TRAE and TRAE SOLO.

### Trace / Request Details
Primary Trace ID:
7573348422486606904:a1f51ef0b0ff5e2e6deec6f10ed8ff87_69dd8c6be218609e68add95d.69e0ec4b50a2117b9eb88f91.69e0ec4b50a2117b9eb88f8d:TRAE SOLO.0.1.5.no_sid.no_ppe.T(2026/4/16 08:03:55)

Additional Trace ID:
.7573348422486606904:c1eea8beffafc83012b0e8b58c983882_69df21d9314ce56d1bcdb2d3.69e1332601ed55776ce06c5b.69e13326e4d99a0921073b72:Trae.T(4/16/2026, 1:06:14 PM)

### Environment
- Product: TRAE + TRAE SOLO
- Version: TRAE SOLO 0.1.5 (see trace line)
- OS: macOS

### Models affected
- GLM 5.1 (Coding Plan)
- GLM 5 Turbo

### Steps to reproduce
1. Select GLM 5.1 or GLM 5 Turbo in TRAE / TRAE SOLO
2. Send any message (also happens in coding/agent flows)
3. Error popup: “Model Request failed. Please try again later. (3003)” + “Copy Request Details”

### Expected behavior
Model responds normally.

### Actual behavior
Request fails with error (3003). Retrying may still fail.

### Notes
Possibly related to #2315 (same error code 3003), but this report confirms it occurs across GLM 5.1 and GLM 5 Turbo and in both TRAE and TRAE SOLO.
